stages.label: Ground, courtyard and pool
stages.description: Lay the ground plane, reserve the courtyard void and sink a pool at its centre.

stages.label: Cantilevered stacks
stages.description: Rasterise every level as a storeyed shell whose roof becomes a garden terrace for the level above.

stages.label: Cores, balconies, channels and bridges
stages.description: Run a stair core up each stack, open every level onto the balcony below it, cut water channels and bridge the stacks.

stages.label: Rule-driven growth
stages.description: Planters on terrace edges, vines down the facades, waterfalls from the channels, gardens across every balcony.

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: Walk from the courtyard to every level; the courtyard must stay open and every cantilever supported.
